system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global gridded long-term temperature and precipitation summaries, including annual means, ranges, seasonality, and wettest, driest, warmest, and coldest monthly or quarterly conditions.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Static long-term climatological normals; the Earth Engine catalog represents the layer with a nominal 1960-1990 interval, so it must not be interpreted as a current-weather or interannual time series.
analytical_capabilities: Mapping long-term temperature and precipitation gradients at global to regional scales
Separating annual mean conditions from seasonality and climatic extremes
Comparing multivariate climate regimes among regions
Identifying combinations of limiting cold, heat, wetness, and dryness conditions
Quantifying climatic similarity, environmental gradients, and spatially unusual climate combinations while auditing predictor collinearity

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: bio01-bio11 are temperature-derived variables, with documented 0.1 degrees Celsius scales except bio03 (%) and bio04 (0.01 degrees Celsius); bio12-bio14 and bio16-bio19 are precipitation in millimetres; bio15 is a precipitation coefficient of variation.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Load the asset as ee.Image('WORLDCLIM/V1/BIO'); apply each band's documented scale before analysis; do not treat the static normal as yearly observations; reduce correlated bio variables or report sensitivity to predictor selection when fitting multivariate models.
